en: A vintage New Year greeting card featuring an illustration of a snowy winter landscape framed by bare, snow‑dusted branches with several small birds perched and in flight. In the center is a moonlit scene of a cottage with a lit window, smoke from the chimney, and a winding snowy path. At the bottom of the card, in ornate script, is a New Year greeting in a Scandinavian language.
